data.body:
[P1] Keep awaited lifecycle hooks active until they settle

Successful replay paths in `createInvokeHandler`, `createCallback`, and `createWaitHandler` mark operations `COMPLETED` before awaiting `onOperationEnd`. With another callback pending, a 10 ms asynchronous hook now lets the 3 ms cooldown return `PENDING` before the caller's next submission step; the previous 20 ms cooldown allowed progress. Several terminal failure paths similarly suspend before delivering the error to recovery code. Keep these operations `EXECUTING` while awaiting their hooks and mark them completed afterward. Add composed tests covering delayed hooks on replay and failure paths before reducing this constant.
